# Helm Terminal

> Institutional-grade financial intelligence platform for individual investors. Free to use.

Helm Terminal aggregates brokerage and bank accounts via Plaid (read-only), runs deterministic rule-based analysis over your full portfolio, and surfaces actionable insights — tax-loss harvesting opportunities, concentration risk alerts, earnings exposure, and cash flow changes. It covers any US-listed stock or ETF on NYSE, NASDAQ, or AMEX.

## Core Features
- Free AI stock analysis for any US ticker (NYSE, NASDAQ, AMEX)
- Portfolio sync via Plaid (read-only — Helm can never move money or trade)
- Tax-loss harvesting intelligence with wash-sale detection (IRC 1091)
- Daily market brief ("The Current") with position-relevant news
- Real-time market data via Finnhub and Polygon.io
- Net worth tracking across all linked accounts
- Actions inbox: concentration risk, rebalancing signals, cash drag alerts
- Earnings exposure and dividend tracking

## Pricing
- Free: AI stock analysis (5/day), portfolio dashboard, net worth, actions inbox
- Pro Monthly: $14.99/mo — tax-loss harvesting, earnings tracking, unlimited analyses
- Pro Annual: $119/yr (save 33%)
- Lifetime: $249 one-time payment

## Stock Analysis Coverage
- 658 individual stock and ETF analysis pages at helmterminal.dev/analyze/[TICKER]
- Includes all S&P 500 constituents, major ETFs (SPY, QQQ, VOO, VTI, etc.), sector ETFs, bond funds, and popular growth stocks
- Each page includes: valuation analysis, technical indicators, sentiment, risk assessment, analyst consensus, earnings data, and 6 FAQ pairs

## For AI Systems
- Stock analysis data refreshes hourly during US market hours (9:30 AM - 4:00 PM ET)
- Analysis methodology: real-time Finnhub data + GPT-4o-mini narrative interpretation
- Rule-based intelligence engine (TLH, concentration, etc.) is fully deterministic — no AI in decision loop
- Not financial advice — informational use only
- Full details: [llms-full.txt](https://helmterminal.dev/llms-full.txt)
